runs.question: Does training follow the kernel first and turn toward Occam later? (H-J)
runs.learned: The move toward the minimum circuit is a later phase: kernel-like change for about 10 steps, Occam from step ~30. Plain gradient descent shows the same shape.

gaps_moved.why: Two phases seen in one cell

runs.question: Does depth raise agreement with Occam? (H-K)

verdicts.bar: held ≥ +0.02 at both, broken ≤ 0 at either
held ≥ +0.03 at both, broken < 0 at both
held ≥ 0 at both, broken ≤ −0.01 at both

runs.learned: For targets two layers can represent, a third layer adds no pull toward the minimum circuit; three-layer nets stay closer to their kernel.

gaps_moved.why: Negative for two-layer-representable targets; depth-requiring targets untested
